tokens.name: color-bg-default
tokens.usage: Page and screen ground. Every text role is measured against it.

tokens.name: color-bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Grouped sections, cards, text fields, the footer's side circles.

tokens.name: color-bg-chrome
tokens.usage: Navigation bars and toolbars; the solid fallback when glass is off.

tokens.usage: Popovers, secondary buttons, the readout bar.

tokens.usage: Bottom and side sheets.

tokens.name: color-bg-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover feedback everywhere. MERGES fathomBgHover and fathomHoverSurface.

tokens.name: color-bg-user-bubble
tokens.usage: The user's own turns in a transcript. Light moves #e8e1d3 → bone-200 (imperceptible).

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, body, control labels. 16.3 / 16.3 / 19:1 on the ground.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, captions, metadata. At least 5.2:1 on every surface. Safety copy uses this, never tertiary.

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: De-emphasized metadata and chevrons only. 6.3 / 4.64 / 15.4:1 on the ground. Never safety copy.

tokens.name: color-text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent, hazard and success fills.

tokens.name: color-text-on-accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on an accent fill (5.4:1 minimum). MERGES #dce3e8 into fog-100.

tokens.name: color-border-control
tokens.usage: A control's edge: buttons, fields, circles, segment groups. Opaque now, and one value in dark and light (was fog-400 at 80% in dark). 3:1 minimum on every surface.

tokens.name: color-border-divider
tokens.usage: Passive dividers only; allowed to be faint. Never a control's edge.

tokens.name: color-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and Switch Control focus: 2pt ring (3pt in Contrast Boost), 3pt outset. 6–7.7:1 on the ground.

tokens.name: color-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Accent BACKGROUNDS only (primary buttons, the mic, selected segments). Never text or glyphs on the page: 2.7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: color-accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent FOREGROUND: glyphs, links, eyebrows, strokes, the open mic. 7.4 / 6.0 / 10.4:1 on the ground.

tokens.name: color-accent-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: tinted buttons, suggestion chips, listening halos. Accent fill at 18% (45% in Contrast Boost).

tokens.name: color-hazard-fg
tokens.usage: Hazard text, glyphs and strokes. MERGES fathomHazard and fathomHazardSignal: the brighter value passes on every surface.

tokens.name: color-hazard-fill
tokens.usage: Hazard backgrounds with white on top: the paused mic's End. Fixed so white holds 6.2:1.

tokens.name: color-hazard-wash
tokens.usage: Alert bubbles and hazard cards.

tokens.name: color-caution-fg
tokens.usage: Attention, pending, the usage ring past 80%, the hazard echo. Light CHANGED to ember-800: 4.5:1 on Bone (was 2.9:1).

tokens.name: color-success-fg
tokens.usage: Confirmation glyphs, dots, the always-on shield. Glyphs and dots only in dark (4.4:1 on raised); pair with a word.

tokens.name: color-success-fill
tokens.usage: Success backgrounds with white on top: the Yes answer, the success disc.

tokens.name: color-success-wash
tokens.usage: The always-on safety card.

tokens.name: color-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled tracks: the usage ring, progress, sheet hairlines.

tokens.name: color-switch-off
tokens.usage: A switch's off-state track. Under 3:1 against its row in every appearance, so the off track always carries a color-border-control edge at border-default (FathomSwitch); the fill is a tone, the line is the boundary.

tokens.name: color-scrim
